title: proxy-build chain
description: The one artifact: an ordered, dependency-validated task list. Order must be a valid linearization of the dependency graph — every depends_on references an EARLIER node id.

docs.description: The spec docs this chain covers. Must be the whole product.

external_inputs.description: Interfaces that enter the product from outside (satisfy a `consumes` with no producing node). e.g. recall.webhook, chat.inbound.

product_endpoints.description: Interfaces that leave the product to the user/world (satisfy an `exposes` with no consuming node). e.g. notes.finalized.

disposition.description: plan-time action from the code-vs-spec audit

spec_refs.description: cited spec sections — the source of truth (file#section); the definition of done

criterion_ids.description: existing AC-* criteria this node verifies against (00-03); empty for 04-09 (judged against spec_refs)

intent.description: what this realizes + what the cited spec means here; cites, never re-copies the spec

definition_of_done.description: concretely what 'done' is AND what does not count as done

consumes.description: interfaces needed (must be produced by an earlier node or be an external_input)

exposes.description: interfaces produced (must be consumed by someone or be a product_endpoint)

depends_on.description: earlier node ids only — no forward references (the acyclic guarantee)

integration_point.description: where in the live product this wires in — file/path, not a standalone module

acceptance_cmd.description: pytest selector args (path + -k filter), run on the real path by build/gates/verify-node.sh — NOT a full shell command

journeys_now_live.description: cumulative product journeys that must pass once this node lands (the verifier's oracle)

invariants.description: product laws this node must not break, e.g. CON-004 call_external seam, isolation triad

risks.description: known hazards for the builder to watch

human_gated.description: true for baseline / extraction-count / migration / deploy touchpoints
